## MSL AI Systems — 02 Client Onboarding & Asset Chaser
**Autonomy Level:** L2 (Deterministic Workspace Provisioning + Isolated AI Kickoff Brief Formatter)

### How to Demo Live on Screen-Share / Loom:
1. Click the orange **Execute workflow** button at the bottom.
2. Node `00` injects a realistic Nigerian agency deposit/deal event, provisions the Google Drive folder structure, formats the asset checklist, and generates the 1-Click WhatsApp & Email asset chaser.
3. Every node runs 100% green out of the box with zero `$env` errors (Node `01` Production Webhook is disabled by default so the orange button always fires `00` immediately).
